parameters.query:
-- Link this execution to the lead (the error handler finds the lead by it) and load
-- everything stored so far. Finished leads are skipped.
UPDATE leads SET pipeline_execution_id = $2, updated_at = now()
WHERE lead_id = $1 AND completed_at IS NULL
RETURNING lead_id, payload AS lead, enrichment_status, enrichment, score, tier, scoring,
          decision, sent_email, email_sent_at, slack_channel, slack_ts;

parameters.jsCode:
// DRY_RUN: record the email instead of sending it.
return [{ json: { dry_action: { type: 'smtp.send', body: $json } } }];

nodes.name: Send email
nodes.notes: no-retry: a retry after the mail server accepted the message would email the lead twice. A failure stops here and the lead becomes error_recoverable; replay resumes.

parameters.query:
-- Recorded as soon as it is sent, so a later failure + replay never sends it again.
UPDATE leads SET
  sent_email = $2::jsonb,
  email_sent_at = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN now() END,
  dry_run_actions = dry_run_actions || $4::jsonb,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE lead_id = $1
RETURNING lead_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Prepare finish').first().json.lead.lead_id, JSON.stringify($('Prepare email').first().json), !$('Dry-run email').isExecuted, $('Dry-run email').isExecuted ? JSON.stringify([$('Dry-run email').first().json.dry_action]) : '[]'] }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  status = $2,
  crm = $3::jsonb,
  completed_at = now(),
  dry_run_actions = dry_run_actions || $4::jsonb,
  error = coalesce(NULLIF($5, ''), error),
  updated_at = now()
WHERE lead_id = $1
RETURNING lead_id, status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Prepare finish').first().json.lead.lead_id, $('Finish').first().json.status, JSON.stringify($('Finish').first().json.crm), JSON.stringify([...$('Finish').first().json.dry_actions, ...($('Dry-run Slack update').isExecuted ? [$('Dry-run Slack update').first().json.dry_action] : [])]), $('Check update reply').isExecuted && $('Check update reply').first().json.slack_update !== 'ok' ? 'Slack outcome update ' + $('Check update reply').first().json.slack_update : ''] }}
